schema.text: Why don't you drive more often? (Select all that apply)
schema.help: We ask this to understand what limits driving for different people. Answering is optional, and you can also choose not to say.

options.text: I don't have a driving licence
I don't have a car available
My health, a disability or my age makes it difficult
I don't need to: other ways of getting around suit me better

en.#Why don't you drive more often? (Select: Why don't you drive more often? (Select all that apply)
en.#We ask this to understand what limits d: We ask this to understand what limits driving for different people. Answering is optional, and you can also choose not to say.
en.#I don't have a driving licence: I don't have a driving licence
en.#I don't have a car available: I don't have a car available
en.#My health, a disability or my age makes: My health, a disability or my age makes it difficult
en.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: I don't need to: other ways of getting around suit me better

it.#Why don't you drive more often? (Select: Perché non guidi più spesso? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#We ask this to understand what limits d: Lo chiediamo per capire che cosa limita l'uso dell'auto per persone diverse. Rispondere è facoltativo e puoi anche scegliere di non dirlo.
it.#My health, a disability or my age makes: La mia salute, una disabilità o l'età me lo rendono difficile
it.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Non mi serve: altri modi di spostarmi sono più adatti a me

fr.#Why don't you drive more often? (Select: Pourquoi ne conduisez-vous pas plus souvent ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#We ask this to understand what limits d: Nous posons cette question pour comprendre ce qui limite la conduite selon les personnes. Répondre est facultatif, et vous pouvez aussi choisir de ne pas le dire.
fr.#I don't have a driving licence: Je n'ai pas le permis de conduire
fr.#I don't have a car available: Je n'ai pas de voiture à disposition
fr.#Parking is hard to find: Il est difficile de trouver une place de stationnement
fr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Ma santé, un handicap ou mon âge rendent cela difficile
fr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Je n'en ai pas besoin : d'autres moyens de déplacement me conviennent mieux

de.#Why don't you drive more often? (Select: Warum fahren Sie nicht häufiger Auto? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#We ask this to understand what limits d: Wir fragen dies, um zu verstehen, was das Autofahren für verschiedene Menschen einschränkt. Die Antwort ist freiwillig, und Sie können auch angeben, dass Sie es lieber nicht sagen möchten.
de.#I don't have a car available: Mir steht kein Auto zur Verfügung
de.#Parking is hard to find: Es ist schwer, einen Parkplatz zu finden
de.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Meine Gesundheit, eine Behinderung oder mein Alter machen es mir schwer
de.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Ich brauche es nicht: Andere Fortbewegungsarten passen besser zu mir

tr.#Why don't you drive more often? (Select: Neden daha sık araba kullanmıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#We ask this to understand what limits d: Bunu, farklı kişiler için araba kullanmayı neyin sınırladığını anlamak için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır; belirtmemeyi de seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Sağlığım, bir engelim veya yaşım bunu zorlaştırıyor
tr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Gerek duymuyorum: başka ulaşım yolları bana daha uygun

fa.#Why don't you drive more often? (Select: چرا بیشتر رانندگی نمی‌کنید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#We ask this to understand what limits d: این را می‌پرسیم تا بفهمیم چه چیزی رانندگی را برای افراد مختلف محدود می‌کند. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و می‌توانید ترجیح دهید آن را نگویید.
fa.#Parking is hard to find: پیدا کردن جای پارک سخت است
fa.#My health, a disability or my age makes: وضعیت سلامتی، معلولیت یا سنم این کار را دشوار می‌کند
fa.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: نیازی ندارم: روش‌های دیگر جابه‌جایی برایم مناسب‌ترند

hu.#Why don't you drive more often? (Select: Miért nem vezet gyakrabban autót? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#We ask this to understand what limits d: Azért kérdezzük, hogy megértsük, mi korlátozza az autóvezetést a különböző emberek számára. A válaszadás nem kötelező, és azt is választhatja, hogy nem kívánja megadni.
hu.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Az egészségi állapotom, egy fogyatékosság vagy a korom megnehezíti
hu.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Nincs rá szükségem: más közlekedési módok jobban megfelelnek nekem

ar.#Why don't you drive more often? (Select: لماذا لا تقود السيارة أكثر؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#We ask this to understand what limits d: نسأل عن ذلك لنفهم ما الذي يحدّ من قيادة السيارة لدى أشخاص مختلفين. الإجابة اختيارية، ويمكنك أيضًا اختيار عدم الإفصاح.
ar.#Parking is hard to find: يصعب العثور على مكان لركن السيارة
ar.#My health, a disability or my age makes: صحتي أو إعاقة أو عمري يجعل ذلك صعبًا
ar.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: لا أحتاج إلى ذلك: وسائل تنقّل أخرى تناسبني أكثر
